## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2015-03-23: Form-of TRA (Mergers) filed as Exhibit 10.7 to S-1/A
- 2015-04-15: Virtu Up-C IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement (Mergers) filed at 85% with SLP III EW Feeder I, L.P. and Havelock Fund Investments Pte Ltd, covering Section 754 basis adjustments and pre-IPO NOL carryforwards attributable to the IPO-time merger participants plus imputed interest; Section 3.03(b) cross-coordinates payments with the parallel non-SLP-Exchanges and SLP-Exchanges TRAs (10-Q Exhibit 10.6)

## Explanation

Virtu Financial, Inc. executed three parallel Tax Receivable Agreements at its April 15, 2015 Up-C IPO; this contract (the "Mergers" TRA) covers the two named entities that delivered Virtu LLC interests into the Up-C via the IPO-time pre-Reorganization merger structure, SLP III EW Feeder I, L.P. and Havelock Fund Investments Pte Ltd. It pays 85% of net cash tax savings on the merger-driven basis adjustments and, distinctively from the other two Virtu TRAs, on pre-IPO net operating loss carryforwards attributable to these participants; the Article II coverage of both Basis Adjustment and NOLs is the principal economic feature setting it apart from the basis-only non-SLP-Exchanges and SLP-Exchanges TRAs. Section 3.03(b) pro-rata-coordinates payments across all three Virtu TRAs. No on-EDGAR amendment, restatement, waiver, or termination has been filed; the contract remains in force as of FY2025 within the aggregate $181.9M Virtu TRA liability. See `contract_log.md` for the cross-contract reasoning and the parallel-TRA structure.
